commit_scope: Restore app.hati.earth's one-tap connection to an existing Hati Suci device identity across browser origins, without adding a second login or accepting a caller-controlled redirect destination.
evidence_refs: Live infrastructure was healthy during diagnosis: app.hati.earth resolved through Cloudflare, GET / returned 200 with x-middleware-rewrite: /grocery, and /api/grocery/categories, /api/household/events, and /api/health-proxy all returned 200.
A clean live browser reached Hati · Belanja without console errors but stopped at the missing-device-token gate, distinguishing identity handoff from DNS, TLS, web, or API failure.
Root cause: app.hati.earth and coherencycoin.com are distinct browser origins, so the grocery app cannot read hatiSuci.token from the canonical board's localStorage.
The recovery destination is fixed to coherencycoin.com/hati-suci?to=grocery and the return destination is fixed to app.hati.earth; no caller-controlled URL enters the handoff.
Local browser proof showed the disconnected grocery surface rendering the new recovery copy and a visible Hati Suci link to http://localhost:3119/hati-suci?to=grocery.
Web validation passed: 25 Vitest files / 147 tests and the Next.js production build.

commands: in-app Chromium recovery-door visibility and href check
